findings.correction: From the hill, Socheon stared at the flickering torches with eyes that seemed to pour fire.
findings.current: From the top of the hill, Socheon stared at the torches flickering in the eyes where flames seemed to pour forth.
findings.defect: The flaming eyes belong to Socheon; he is looking at the torches, not seeing torches flicker inside eyes.
findings.rationale: 불길이 쏟아지는 눈동자로 modifies how Socheon looks; 일렁이는 횃불들 is the object.
findings.source: 언덕 위, 소천은 불길이 쏟아지는 눈동자로 일렁이는 횃불들을 바라봤다.

findings.correction: I was worried because you hadn’t come for more than half a shichen.
findings.current: I was worried because you hadn’t come for more than half an hour.
findings.defect: 시진 is a two-hour watch; 반 시진 is about an hour, not thirty minutes.
findings.rationale: Quantity of waiting time is changed.
findings.source: 반 시진이 넘도록 안 오시기에 걱정했습니다.

findings.correction: ...the sight of her back as she led the others away.
findings.current: Her voice still lingered before his eyes, along with the sight of her back as she left with the others.
findings.defect: 이끌고 is leading the others away, not merely leaving with them.
findings.rationale: Her last image is as the one taking people out, not as a companion in a group departure.
findings.source: 그 목소리가, 다른 사람들을 이끌고 떠나던 그 뒷모습이 아직도 눈앞에 아른거렸다.

findings.correction: Attack formation. Form up! / Defensive formation. Form up!
findings.current: Attack formation. Spread out! / Defensive formation. Spread out!
findings.defect: 대형 펼쳐 means deploy/form up; “spread out” reads as dispersing, the opposite tactic.
findings.rationale: The squad is assembling taught formations, then later a defensive one so Taekyung can take last hits.
findings.source: 공격 대형. 펼쳐! / 수비 대형, 펼쳐!

findings.defect: The confused/surprised 응? after seeing Lv.12/11/12 is omitted, so the comic beat that the pursuers are weak is lost.
findings.rationale: The line is Taekyung’s reaction to the levels, not a silent pause.

findings.correction: I advanced with the Manoeuvre Technique, bored into their center, and swung my spear.
findings.current: I stepped forward, bored into their center, and swung my spear.
findings.defect: 보법을 밟아 is executing the manoeuvre/footwork technique, not a generic step.
findings.rationale: Follows the line that Jin Family Manoeuvre and Spear Techniques are built on pressing forward.
findings.source: 나는 보법을 밟아 나갔다. 중심으로 파고들며 창을 휘둘렀다.

findings.defect: 푸화악 is a bursting/splattering impact, not an airy whoosh; the next line is the chest exploding.
findings.rationale: Onomatopoeia should match the cannonball-like burst of the chest, not a swing through air.

summary: Several semantic errors: Socheon’s blazing eyes are attached to the torches; 반 시진 is rendered as half an hour; Mother is said to leave with others rather than lead them; formation orders become “spread out”; Taekyung’s stunned 응? at the levels is dropped; footwork technique is reduced to stepping; the finishing strike’s burst SFX becomes a whoosh.
